reason: Machine lens: all 30 removed instructions are LDA abs (AD, 3 bytes, 4 cycles; zp_save at &BC00 page, no index so no page-cross penalty) and STA zp (85, 2 bytes, 3 cycles): 15 x 7 = 105 cycles, 15 x 5 = 75 bytes. Listing: restore_game_zp at &8D95, LDA zp_save + 17 at &8DE0 = &8D95 + 75, so SKIP 75 before the label keeps the tail and everything after at their addresses; no branches or indexed reads in the region, nothing moves across a page. Only entry is render's JMP restore_game_zp (&9376, absolute, same cost to the new &8DE0); no 'restore_game_zp +' entries, no stores into its operands, no data reads of these bytes. The padding follows save_game_zp's RTS so it is never executed. Plain SKIP and backslash comments are valid Baron. Removed pairs touch only A/N/Z, which the next LDA overwrites. Semantics of the dropped restores (that the bytes already hold the saved values) is outside this lens.
